question: What would come in (5)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage emphasizes that modern professionals seek not only financial stability but also personal satisfaction in their careers.
 
• The word in blank (5) should reflect a quality that makes life fulfilling and meaningful, complementing security and stability.
 
• Option **3: rewarding** (संतोषजनक) correctly conveys this idea, indicating that the life built is fulfilling and satisfying.
 
• Other options like wealthy, creative, or routine either focus solely on financial gain, innovation, or monotony, which do not capture the sense of holistic fulfillment.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** wealthy (धनवान) – Focuses only on financial status, not holistic fulfillment.
 
• **Option 2:** creative (रचनात्मक) – While important, it does not capture overall life satisfaction.
 
• **Option 4:** routine (नियमित/साधारण) – Suggests monotony, opposite of a fulfilling life.
